newsitem.title: QATAR: Bulls push Qatar stocks 1.6 pct higher in week.
newsitem.headline: Bulls push Qatar stocks 1.6 pct higher in week.

text.p: Bullish sentiment on the Qatar stock exchange pushed share prices 1.6 percent higher in the week to Thursday, dealers said.

The Commercial Bank of Qatar's 17-share index climbed to a 145.24 point close from 142.93 points the previous week. This brought the rise since the launch of the official Doha Securities Market on May 27 to 12.4 percent.
In the week, nine shares advanced, one declined and seven were steady. Over 9,200 shares worth 2.6 million riyals ($714,000) were traded.
Banks took the lead with 5,382 shares valued at 1.85 million riyals changing hands.
In terms of value traded, services stocks came next, followed by insurers and industrials.
As a share of turnover, banks came first with 58 percent followed by industrials with 23 percent, services with 15 percent and insurance stocks with four percent.
Market leader Qatar National Bank rose 14 riyals to 615, Qatar Islamic Bank gathered six riyals to 184.75 and Qatar International Islamic Bank climbed seven riyals to 110.
Continued confidence in Qatar General Insurance's profitability sent the share 50 riyals -- or 10 percent -- to 550 in one transaction. Qatar Insurance gained 15 riyals to 600.
Qatar Navigation added 9.50 riyals to 780 and Qatar Leisure moved up one riyal to 52.
Qatar Cement advanced 27 riyals to 352 and Qatar Flour Mills gained 10 riyals to 340. Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Company shed one riyal to 69.
